name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
summary: Income support for qualifying landholding farmer families, subject to exclusions and government verification.

rules.label: No PM-KISAN exclusion applies to the family

limitations: Self-reported land and exclusions cannot establish official eligibility. Government land records, family definition, date of land acquisition, state exceptions and registration must be checked with the official portal.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
benefit: Central contribution: ₹200 monthly ages 60–79, ₹500 monthly from age 80; state top-ups vary
summary: NSAP old-age pension for a person aged 60 or over in a BPL household.

rules.label: Household is BPL under the official list/criteria

limitations: Income amount by itself does not prove BPL status. Government/local authority must verify BPL record and application.

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
benefit: Central contribution: ₹300 monthly (state additions may vary)
summary: NSAP pension for BPL widows aged 40–59.

rules.label: Household is BPL under official criteria

limitations: Government/local authority must verify widow and BPL status; this tool cannot determine official entitlement.

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
benefit: Central contribution: ₹300 monthly (state additions may vary)
summary: NSAP pension for BPL people aged 18–59 with severe or multiple disabilities.

rules.label: Household is BPL under official criteria

limitations: Government/local authority must verify disability classification and BPL status; this tool cannot determine official entitlement.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
benefit: ₹2 lakh life cover on death from any cause; annual premium applies
summary: Renewable one-year life insurance for participating bank or post-office account holders enrolling at ages 18–50.
limitations: This age comparison alone cannot establish eligibility or coverage. A participating bank/post-office account, consent to auto-debit, premium, enrolment period, exclusions and current terms need verification. The official page listed an annual premium of ₹436 when checked in September 2026; verify before joining.

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
benefit: Accident cover up to ₹2 lakh for death or specified permanent disability; annual premium applies
summary: Renewable one-year accident insurance for participating bank or post-office account holders aged 18–70.
limitations: Age alone cannot establish enrolment or coverage. A participating bank/post-office account, consent to auto-debit, sufficient balance, accident definition and current terms must be verified. The official page listed a ₹20 annual premium when checked in September 2026; verify before joining.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
benefit: Contribution-based guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000–₹5,000 from age 60, depending on contribution
summary: Contributory pension option for citizens enrolling at ages 18–40 with a savings account; income-tax payer exclusion applies to new enrolment.
limitations: Age alone cannot establish eligibility. Savings account, nationality, contribution choice and tax-payer exclusion for joiners since October 2022 must be verified with the official source. This is not a welfare payout without contributions.
